big_case.notes: The notice required for consent to general jurisdiction affects multistate businesses and forum choice nationally. This petition presents a bounded post-Mallory issue through a default-judgment dispute with contested preservation and alternative jurisdictional grounds. Moderate national stakes if resolved on the merits; denial supplies no new doctrinal rule.
